items.title: Support / Donate
items.body: New Settings entry to support FloatNative's development.

items.title: Force Landscape
items.body: Lock to landscape from the player even when rotation lock is on.

items.title: Playback Speed Sticks
items.body: Your chosen playback speed now carries from one video to the next. Apple TV gets a Speed menu too.

items.title: Android TV / Fire TV stays awake
items.body: Screen no longer dims during playback.
